title: SE State Resume Pointer Schema
description: Schema for .se-state.yaml — the resumable state pointer for SE cascade. Enables session recovery after token-loss without re-running completed steps.

project.description: Project name this state belongs to.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state mutation.

current_node.description: Name of the current system/node being processed.

agent.description: Name of the agent that completed the last step.

status.description: Status of the last completed step.

output_file.description: Relative path from docs/se/<project>/ to the output file.

next_expected_step.description: The next step to resume with on session restart.

input_files.description: Files to load as context for the next step.

pending_decisions.description: Decisions that need to be made before continuing.
